d: Most games hand you the keys to the kingdom immediately, but Kingdom Come: Deliverance isn't most games. It’s infamous for a brutal first 10 hours where you can’t read, can’t fight, and basically get bullied by farmers. It takes patience to push through that initial grind, but once the mechanics click, the immersion is unmatched—from sharpening your own blade to guards actually remembering your face. It’s a slow burn that pays off for those willing to put in the work. #gaming #rpg #kingdomcomedeliverance #gamingrecommendations #hardcoregaming

d: "Laica" is half dating sim, half survival horror, where you live with a girl on a space station that's being eaten alive. You wake up in HOME, a habitat drifting somewhere in space, and the only other person there is a girl called Laica who has been living in it entirely alone. So you do ordinary things. Share meals. Put music on. Go on small adventures around the station. Float together in zero gravity because there is nothing stopping you. Then you go outside. The world beyond HOME is dark and there are grotesque things moving in it, and the game turns into first-person survival horror for as long as you are out there. You come back, and it is another ordinary day with Laica. That rhythm is the whole design, and the reason it works is that something is quietly eating away at space itself, so the calm half has a clock running under it. Developed by Santa Studio, coming to PC on Steam. #Laica #SurvivalHorror #HorrorGames #FirstPersonHorror #SciFiHorror #SpaceStation #NarrativeGames #StoryRich #SliceOfLife #DatingSim #CosmicHorror #SantaStudio #AtmosphericGames #IndieGame #IndieDev #IndieGames #SteamGames #PCGaming #Wishlist #GamingNews #GameTrailer #ComingSoon #SingleplayerGames #AnimeStyle #GamingWorld

zh: 《Laica》一半是恋爱模拟，一半是生存恐怖。你与一个女孩同住在一个正被蚕食的空间站里。你在HOME中醒来，这是漂流在太空某处的栖息地，唯一的同伴是独自在此生活已久的女孩Laica。你们做些日常的事：一起吃饭、放音乐、在空间站里小小探险、在零重力下一同漂浮。然后你走出舱外，HOME之外的世界一片黑暗，有怪异的东西在其中移动，只要身处舱外，游戏就变为第一人称生存恐怖。你回到舱内，又是与Laica共度的平常一天。这种节奏贯穿整个设计，而它奏效的原因在于，有什么东西正在悄然侵蚀空间本身，因此平静的那一半生活之下，时钟一直在滴答作响。由Santa Studio开发，将登陆Steam PC平台。

d: "BRUSHLAND" is a cozy fairytale kingdom-builder where you paint a country into existence one tile at a time and tend to its villagers. You shape the land, welcome the villagers and tend to their needs until a handful of tiles becomes a country they love. Where you paint matters: each tile reacts to its neighbors, so a house surrounded by fields can turn into a windmill. Villagers arrive by boat with requests, and you build bridges, mines and cottages to meet them. There is no clock and no failure state, so you can take it at your own pace. A level editor lets you save a finished kingdom as a short text code to share with others. It is a single-player game. Brushland is made by Transhuman Design. You can wishlist it on Steam now. #Brushland #KingdomBuilder #CityBuilder #CozyGames #CozyGaming #Fairytale #RelaxingGames #Simulation #Strategy #LevelEditor #IndieGame #IndieGames #PCGaming #PCGames #Steam #SteamGames #Wishlist #NewGameAlert #GameTrailer #GamingNews #GamingWorld #Gamer #Gaming

d: #sponsored by Pipes.exe   You are the lowest-ranked QA tester at System 6D, and your test environment is a screensaver that fights back.   Pipes.exe is a first-person co-op horror and comedy game from Moving Pieces Interactive, published by CRITICAL REFLEX, for 1 to 4 players. You test the company's geometry system by climbing and parkouring through procedurally generated 3D worlds, collecting artifacts and returning them to a recycling bin while environmental threats and enemies escalate. You earn points from assignments to spend in the company shop and unlock cosmetics, and a no-swearing rule docks your daily performance review points. It's coming soon with no release date announced. #fyp #indiegame #adventure

d: @🗣️𝘾𝙮𝙣 𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐜𝐡🌟 Violence District (VD) บน Roblox เป็นหนึ่งในเกมแนว Asymmetrical Horror (สยองขวัญแบบผู้เล่นไม่สมมาตร) ที่ได้รับความนิยมสูงมากในหมู่ผู้เล่น Roblox โดยมีรูปแบบการเล่นหลักที่ได้แรงบันดาลใจและถอดแบบมาจากเกมสยองขวัญชื่อดังอย่าง Dead by Daylight (DbD)   ​สำหรับประวัติความเป็นมา แนวคิด และพัฒนาการที่น่าสนใจของแมพหรือเกม Violence District มีรายละเอียดดังนี้ครับ:   ​1. จุดเริ่มต้นและแรงบันดาลใจ (Origins & Inspiration) ​แนวคิดหลัก: ตัวเกมถูกสร้างขึ้นมาเพื่อตอบโจทย์แฟน ๆ เกมแนวไล่าล่า-เอาชีวิตรอด (1 vs 5) โดยแบ่งผู้เล่นเป็น Killer (ผู้ล่า) 1 คนที่มีพลังและความสามารถพิเศษเฉพาะตัว และ Survivors (ผู้รอดชีวิต) 5 คนที่ต้องร่วมมือกันทำภารกิจ ​ต้นแบบทางความคิด: ระบบการเล่นหลัก ๆ อ้างอิงจาก Dead by Daylight เช่น ฝ่ายผู้รอดชีวิตต้องช่วยกันซ่อมแซมเครื่องปั่นไฟ (Generators), เปิดประตูหนีภัย (Exit Gates) และหลบหนีการไล่ล่า ขณะที่ฝ่ายคิลเลอร์ต้องตามล่า ขัดขวาง และนำผู้รอดชีวิตไปแขวนหรือสังเวย ​2. วิวัฒนาการและความนิยม (Growth & Popularity) ​การเติบโตอย่างรวดเร็ว: ด้วยความที่ตัวเกมมีการใส่ระบบเมคานิกที่ลึกซึ้ง เช่น ระบบ Perks (ความสามารถเสริมของเซอร์ไวเวอร์), ไอเทมช่วยเหลือ, แผนที่ที่หลากหลาย (เช่น Woodview Cabin, Mercy Hospital, Firelink Temple) รวมถึงตัวละคร Killer ที่มีสไตล์การเล่นหลากหลาย ทำให้เกมนี้ไต่อันดับขึ้นสู่ Top 10 เกมที่มีผู้เล่นพร้อมกันสูงสุดบน Roblox ​การอัปเดตอย่างต่อเนื่อง: ทีมผู้พัฒนาได้มีการปล่อยแพตช์ใหญ่อย่างสม่ำเสมอ ทั้งการรีเวิร์คตัวละคร Killer ตัวเก่า, การเพิ่มตัวละครใหม่ ๆ ที่มีความสามารถโดดเด่น (เช่น The Hidden, The Veil, หรือ The Cure ที่อ้างอิงธีม SCP) รวมถึงการปรับสมดุลเพิร์ก (Perks) และไอเทมใหม่อยู่ตลอดเวลา ทำให้สังคมผู้เล่น (Community) มีการเติบโตและแอคทีฟมาก ทั้งในแง่ของการทำ Wiki, Trello, และการแข่งขันกันในดิสคอร์ด   ​3. ระบบการเล่นที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์ของ Violence District ​รูปแบบ 1 vs 5: แตกต่างจากต้นฉบับหลาย ๆ เกมที่มักจะเป็น 1 vs 4 แต่ Violence District เลือกใช้สัดส่วน ผู้รอดชีวิต 5 คน ต่อ ฆาตกร 1 คน ทำให้การวางแผน การแบ่งหน้าที่ซ่อมเครื่องปั่นไฟ (Gen Rush) และการช่วยเพื่อนร่วมทีม (Rescue/Looping) มีความวุ่นวายและท้าทายมากยิ่งขึ้น   ​ความหลากหลายของ Killer: ฆาตกรในเกมนี้ไม่ได้มีแค่แนวไล่ฟันธรรมดา แต่มีตั้งแต่แนวซุ่มโจมตี (Stealth) ไปจนถึงตัวละครที่มีสกิลซับซ้อน มินียนช่วยสู้ หรือการควบคุมพื้นที่ ทำให้ผู้เล่นต้องศึกษาแผนที่และวิธีรับมือที่แตกต่างกันไปในแต่ละตา   ​ปัจจุบัน Violence District d: What's actually holding up social deduction? I usually design absent genre. FaeKin started at Discord, after the Among Us boom, as a social deduction game. What came out of it was a deconstruction of the pillars that make the genre tick: a waterfall of information from private to semi-private to public, and a reflection back up it. nevergreengames.com #gamedev #gamedesign #socialdeduction #amongus #boardgames #shorts
h: gamedev, gamedesign, socialdeduction, AmongUs, boardgames, shorts
zh: 社交推理游戏的支柱到底是什么？我做设计时通常不考虑游戏类型。《FaeKin》在《Among Us》爆火后诞生于 Discord，最初是一款社交推理游戏。最终它解构了支撑这一类型的核心：信息从私密到半私密再到公开的瀑布式流动，以及自下而上的反向回流。nevergreengames.com

d: "Undefeated: Genesis" is an open-world superhero RPG where you fly freely across an alien planet, with a free demo out now on Steam. You play Albert Hartree, a young man who always wanted to be a hero and then wakes up on Voltissia, an alien world where he suddenly has the powers to be one. Five hundred years ago an explosion wiped out the civilisation here, and what is left is a strange mix of overgrown wilderness, shattered cities, and lifeforms that should not exist. Al is caught in the middle of it, protecting what remains of the Enelf people. Flight is the whole point. There is no traversal system bolted on the side: you take off whenever you want, move between ground and sky without a loading beat, and fight in the air as readily as on the ground. Combat is fast and power-driven against mutant enemies, and every new ability you unlock through battle changes how you explore and how you approach the next fight. It is the Superman power fantasy played straight, on a ruined alien planet. Developed by Indie-us Games, an Epic MegaGrants recipient and multiple BitSummit award winner, and published by Chorus Worldwide Games, Undefeated: Genesis is coming to PC via Steam and PlayStation 5 in 2027. d: 🇰🇷 NUESTRO PROPIO MUNDO | Episodio 3 Algo empieza a cambiar entre ellos… Todo comenzó con una pregunta aparentemente inocente: «¿A qué hora sales?» Pero cuando Min-ji termina su turno y descubre que Hyuk todavía está afuera de la cafetería, empieza a sospechar que quizá no estaba preguntando por simple curiosidad. Hyuk intenta disimular diciendo que «solo iba hacia allá» y ambos terminan caminando juntos por las calles de Seúl. Cuando su chofer finalmente lo encuentra, Hyuk le ofrece llevarla a casa en su automóvil, pero Min-ji, fiel a su manera independiente de ser, rechaza la propuesta y continúa hacia la parada del autobús. Lo que ella jamás imaginó fue que Hyuk dejaría atrás su lujoso automóvil para subir al autobús con ella. 😳❤️ Dentro, Min-ji descubre algo bastante divertido: el heredero que parece tenerlo todo ni siquiera está acostumbrado a viajar en transporte público. 😂 Pero entre bromas y pequeñas sonrisas llega una pregunta mucho más importante. Si su automóvil viene siguiéndolos… ¿por qué Hyuk decidió quedarse en el autobús? Su respuesta sorprende a Min-ji: «Quería acompañarte.» ❤️ Por primera vez, las barreras entre ellos empiezan a bajar. Min-ji se permite sonreír, bromear e incluso reír genuinamente con él. Pero cuando llegan al humilde barrio donde vive Min-ji, algo cambia. Hyuk quiere continuar acompañándola, pero ella se detiene: «No. Desde aquí estoy bien.» Hyuk respeta su decisión y la deja marcharse sola. Lo que él no alcanza a ver es que, segundos después, Min-ji revisa su teléfono… y la sonrisa que llevaba en el rostro desaparece por completo. ¿Qué vio Min-ji? ¿Qué parte de su vida todavía está intentando más  lejos de Hyuk?  #kdramas kdrama #DramaCoreano #kdramaromance #seriecoreana #kdramafans

d: ❤️🔥 F4 Thailand: Boys Over Flowers is such an amazing Thai drama filled with romance, jealousy, heartbreak, friendship, drama, and unforgettable love! 😭💗 The story follows Gorya, a strong and hardworking girl who enters a world of wealthy, powerful boys known as F4. At first, she clashes with Thyme, the rich and arrogant leader of the group, but as time goes on, their relationship slowly turns into a beautiful love story. 🥹💕 Even though they face misunderstandings, painful moments, jealousy, and challenges, their feelings for each other become stronger. What makes this show so special is the character development, the friendships, the emotional scenes, and the way love can change someone’s heart. Thyme’s journey from a spoiled, arrogant boy into someone who learns to love and care for others is one of my favorite parts! ❤️‍🩹🌹 And let’s not forget the handsome F4 boys, their chemistry, and all the moments that make us laugh, cry, and fall in love with the story! 😍🔥 If you love Thai dramas with romance, rich boys, a strong female lead, heartbreak, and a little bit of jealousy, F4 Thailand is definitely worth watching! 💖 Have you watched F4 Thailand, and are you Team Thyme or Team Ren? 👀💕 Let me know in the comments! #F4Thailand #F4ThailandBoysOverFlowers #ThaiDrama #ThaiDramaLovers #BrightWin

d: ONE PUNCH MAN: Is Saitama Really the Strongest Character in the Entire Universe? What if the strongest hero in the world hasn't even reached his true limits? In One Punch Man, Saitama is famous for defeating almost every opponent with a single punch. But the manga has introduced increasingly powerful enemies, cosmic abilities, and battles that challenge our understanding of his strength. From Garou's cosmic transformation to the mysterious power of God, the manga raises a fascinating question: Is Saitama truly unbeatable, or have we only seen a fraction of his real power? Garou was able to copy Saitama's strength and use cosmic techniques that threatened the entire planet. Yet, as the battle continued, Saitama's power kept growing, leaving Garou unable to keep up. And then there's God, a mysterious entity whose true abilities and intentions remain largely unknown. Could he become the first opponent capable of pushing Saitama into a serious fight? But here's the biggest mystery: Saitama doesn't seem interested in becoming stronger. He's searching for excitement, a genuine challenge, and an opponent who can make him feel something again. So what do you think? Will God finally give Saitama the fight he's been waiting for, or will the series prove that absolutely nobody can defeat the Caped Baldy?#trending#viralvideo#aura#onepunchman

d: Mimic is a short horror film that begins with a woman desperately running through a quiet neighborhood while being chased by a car. When she encounters a man walking his dog, something horrifying happens—the woman suddenly appears to have transformed into him. Whatever is stalking the neighborhood can imitate the appearance and voice of other people, allowing it to move unnoticed and search for its next victim.  The creature eventually makes its way into a house where two young sisters are awake late at night. As the girls move through the house, strange voices and unsettling movements make them realize that something is seriously wrong. What makes Mimic terrifying is that the creature doesn't simply attack—it copies the people the victims trust most, making it almost impossible to know who is real. The short builds its tension around that disturbing idea before ending with a chilling reveal involving the girls' mother.  #Scary #fyp #mimic #movies #moviescenes

d: 🎥🎬: Don’t Turn Out the Lights (2024) Don’t Turn Out the Lights is a horror film that follows a group of friends who set out on a road trip, hoping to enjoy a memorable getaway together. What begins as an ordinary adventure soon takes a disturbing turn as they find themselves in an increasingly frightening situation. As the journey continues, the group encounters unsettling events that make them question whether they are truly safe. The atmosphere becomes tense, and the friends begin to realize that their trip may not end the way they expected. When their recreational vehicle breaks down on a deserted road, the friends become stranded far from help. Strange occurrences begin to surround them, and they realize that something mysterious is lurking in the woods. With no clear explanation for the danger, their excitement quickly turns into panic.  As fear takes over, the friends struggle to stay together and make sensible decisions. Their situation becomes more desperate as they encounter terrifying events that seem to defy explanation. The darkness around them makes every sound and movement feel like a potential threat. As the night progresses, the group faces a fight for survival against an unknown supernatural force. Their journey becomes a chilling nightmare, testing their courage, trust, and determination as they search for a way out. d: Na Indonésia existe uma figura do folclore que parece ter saído diretamente de um pesadelo: o Pocong. 👻🇮🇩 Segundo a lenda, o Pocong seria o espírito de uma pessoa morta que permanece preso ao próprio kafan, o tecido utilizado para envolver o corpo durante o funeral. A tradição conta que os nós do tecido deveriam ser desfeitos após o sepultamento, e quando isso não acontece, o espírito ficaria preso à mortalha. É por isso que as representações do Pocong mostram uma figura completamente coberta por um pano branco, com o corpo amarrado e se movimentando de uma maneira bastante peculiar. Em algumas histórias, ele aparece pulando ou se deslocando rigidamente durante a noite. 😨 A criatura se tornou uma das figuras mais conhecidas do terror e do folclore sobrenatural da Indonésia, aparecendo em filmes, histórias populares e relatos de supostos encontros. Se você encontrasse um desses no meio da noite… provavelmente nem lembraria como correr. 😂 Pocong, Pocong Indonésia, folclore indonésio, espíritos da Indonésia, lendas sobrenaturais, cultura indonésia, terror asiático, lendas urbanas, fantasmas, criaturas assustadoras. #Pocong #Folclore #Terror #Curiosidades #Paranormal

d: Misteri Puluhan Bungkusan Kain Kafan di Canguk Magelang Terkuak Misteri penemuan puluhan bungkusan kain kafan menyerupai pocong kecil di area pembuangan tanah uruk halaman masjid kawasan Canguk, Kota Magelang, Jawa Tengah, akhirnya terkuak secara medis dan hukum. Hasil pemeriksaan tim dokter forensik RSUD Tidar Kota Magelang pada Selasa (20/10/2026) memastikan bahwa seluruh material tulang dan jaringan kulit di dalam bungkusan tersebut bukanlah kerangka manusia. Dokter spesialis forensik RSUD Tidar, dr. Arso Pranindyo Utomo, M.Biomed., Sp.FM, memaparkan bukti anatomi yang tidak sesuai dengan struktur tubuh manusia, seperti tulang rahang berukuran amat kecil dengan susunan gigi tajam, jumlah tulang kering dan paha yang tak lazim, serta ditemukannya sampel kulit berbulu tebal. Hasil analisa menyimpulkan tulang-tulang tersebut berasal dari spesies hewan berkaki empat (kemungkinan sejenis kucing atau anjing). Kapolres Magelang Kota, AKBP Dikri Olfandi, mengonfirmasi bahwa material bungkusan tersebut terbawa dari tanah urukan yang dibuang di lokasi. Untuk mengakhiri spekulasi dan menjaga kondusivitas warga, pihak kepolisian bersama tokoh masyarakat setempat segera menguburkan seluruh material tulang tersebut. (yrp/mon)

d: Misteri benda raksasa yang ditemukan di perkebunan kelapa sawit di Kabupaten Kotawaringin Timur, Kalimantan Tengah, akhirnya mulai menemukan titik terang. Sebelumnya, warga dihebohkan dengan suara dentuman keras dari langit pada Minggu sore, 18 Oktober 2026. Sehari kemudian, benda misterius berukuran besar ditemukan di perkebunan sawit hingga sempat memunculkan dugaan sebagai bangkai pesawat. Namun, perkembangan terbaru mengungkap dugaan yang berbeda. Benda tersebut diduga kuat merupakan serpihan roket antariksa asal China! Tak hanya satu, serpihan logam berukuran besar lainnya juga ditemukan di sekitar lokasi. Bentuknya beragam, mulai dari komponen menyerupai kubah hingga lembaran logam tebal yang berserakan di area perkebunan. Berdasarkan informasi yang disampaikan dalam laporan terbaru, serpihan tersebut diduga berkaitan dengan roket ZhuQue-2E atau ZQ-2E milik China yang kembali memasuki atmosfer Bumi. Analisis data orbit disebut menjadi salah satu petunjuk untuk mengungkap asal-usul benda misterius tersebut. Sementara itu, dugaan awal mengenai bangkai pesawat mulai mengarah pada kemungkinan puing antariksa. Petugas gabungan pun melakukan pemeriksaan dan pengamanan di sekitar lokasi penemuan untuk memastikan kondisi serta mengidentifikasi material yang ditemukan. Masyarakat diimbau agar tidak mendekati, menyentuh, ataupun memindahkan serpihan tersebut sebelum dinyatakan aman oleh pihak berwenang. Meski dugaan asal-usulnya mulai terungkap, identifikasi resmi dan penjelasan lebih lanjut dari instansi terkait tetap diperlukan untuk memastikan jenis serta sumber setiap material yang ditemukan. Dari suara dentuman misterius di langit hingga penemuan benda raksasa di tengah perkebunan sawit, peristiwa di Kotawaringin Timur ini menjadi perhatian publik. Kini, masyarakat menantikan penjelasan resmi mengenai serpihan yang diduga berasal dari roket antariksa China tersebut.

d: 🕯️ 10 เรื่องลึกของ “ถ้ำเสรีไทย ภูพาน” ถ้ำที่ไม่ได้ซ่อนแค่ความมืด… แต่เคยซ่อนชะตาของประเทศ ━ 1️⃣ ที่นี่ไม่ใช่ถ้ำธรรมดา ถ้ำเสรีไทยคือร่องรอยของขบวนการใต้ดินช่วงสงครามโลกครั้งที่ 2 พื้นที่ภูพานเคยถูกใช้เป็นฉากหลังของการเคลื่อนไหวลับ ที่ต้องอาศัยทั้งป่า ภูเขา และความไว้ใจของคนในพื้นที่ ━ 2️⃣ ทำไมต้องเป็น “ภูพาน” เพราะภูพานไม่ใช่แค่ภูเขา แต่เป็นแนวป่าที่ซับซ้อน มีทางเดินธรรมชาติ มีจุดหลบสายตา เหมาะกับการซ่อนคน ซ่อนของ และเคลื่อนกำลังโดยไม่ให้ถูกจับตา ━ 3️⃣ ถ้ำนี้เคยเกี่ยวกับอาวุธและเสบียง เรื่องเล่าทางประวัติศาสตร์ระบุว่า ถ้ำเสรีไทยเคยเป็นจุดสะสมอาวุธยุทธภัณฑ์และเสบียง ไม่ใช่เพื่อสร้างสงคราม แต่เพื่อเตรียมรับมือในวันที่ประเทศอาจไม่มีทางเลือก ━ 4️⃣ เส้นทางรอบถ้ำไม่ใช่ทางเดินเล่นธรรมดา เส้นทางธรรมชาติรอบถ้ำยาวประมาณ 5 กิโลเมตร ผ่านป่าเต็งรัง ป่าเบญจพรรณ จุดชมพระอาทิตย์ และทุ่งกระเจียว แต่มองอีกมุม นี่อาจเคยเป็น “เส้นเลือดลับ” ของการลำเลียงข่าวและเสบียง ━ 5️⃣ ชื่อ “ขุนพลภูพาน” ไม่ได้มาเพราะบังเอิญ เตียง ศิริขันธ์ คือหนึ่งในแกนสำคัญของเสรีไทยสายอีสาน เขาไม่ได้เป็นแค่คนในประวัติศาสตร์ แต่เป็นภาพแทนของเครือข่ายคนธรรมดาที่เลือกยืนอยู่ข้างเอกราช ━ 6️⃣ รหัสลับ “พลูโต” ในโลกของปฏิบัติการใต้ดิน ชื่อจริงอาจอันตรายเกินไป รหัสลับจึงไม่ใช่แค่ชื่อเรียก แต่มันคือเกราะป้องกันชีวิตของทั้งคนส่งข่าว คนรับข่าว และคนร่วมขบวน ━ 7️⃣ คนในพื้นที่คือกำลังสำคัญ เสรีไทยไม่ได้ขับเคลื่อนด้วยผู้นำเพียงคนเดียว แต่ต้องพึ่งชาวบ้าน ครู กำนัน ผู้ใหญ่บ้าน และคนธรรมดาที่รู้เส้นทางป่า เพราะในภูมิประเทศแบบนี้ คนรู้พื้นที่คือกุญแจของทุกภารกิจ ━ 8️⃣ ความลี้ลับของถ้ำ อาจเกิดจากความทรงจำ บางคนเล่าถึงบรรยากาศเหมือนมีคนเดิน แสงตะเกียงลึกในป่า หรือความรู้สึกเหมือนพื้นที่นี้ยังไม่เคยว่างเปล่า บางทีสิ่งที่เรากลัว… อาจไม่ใช่ผี แต่อาจเป็น “เสียงสะท้อนของประวัติศาสตร์” ━ 9️⃣ ถ้ำที่เงียบที่สุด อาจเคยดังที่สุด ในวันที่สงครามยังไม่จบ ทุกเสียงกิ่งไม้หัก ทุกแสงไฟ และทุกฝีเท้า อาจหมายถึงชีวิตของคนทั้งเครือข่าย ━ 🔟 วันนี้ถ้ำเสรีไทยคือบทเรียน มันเตือนเราว่า เอกราชไม่ได้เกิดจากคำประกาศสวยงาม แต่เกิดจากคนจำนวนมากที่ทำงานในเงามืด โดยหวังเพียงให้ประเทศยังเป็นของคนไทย ━ ทุกตำนาน… มักมีความจริงซ่อนอยู่เสมอ #โคตรลี้ลับ #บันทึกลับ #ความลึกลับ #ประวัติศาสตร์ลับ #ปริศนาโลก #ถ้ำเสรีไทย #ภูพาน #สกลนคร #เสรีไทย #ขุนพลภูพาน d: ออกแบบความลึกลับ ให้มีแสงนำทาง 🌿✨ ฉาก Enchanted Forest ใน “Boon Phawade The Musical” ถ่ายทอดบรรยากาศป่าแห่งจินตนาการ ผ่านการจัดวางแสง สี และมิติของภาพ เพื่อชวนผู้ชมรู้สึกราวกับกำลังเดินลึกเข้าไปในเรื่องราว แนวกิ่งไม้โอบล้อมฉากเป็นกรอบธรรมชาติ ขณะที่ทางเดินและขั้นหินค่อย ๆ นำสายตาไปสู่แสงตรงกลาง เกิดเป็นจุดรวมสายตาที่ชวนให้สงสัยว่า…ปลายทางมีอะไรรออยู่ โทนเขียวเข้มและเงาลึกสร้างความสงบปนลึกลับ ตัดกับแสงสีเขียวอมฟ้าที่ช่วยเปิดระยะของป่า ส่วนประกายแสงเล็ก ๆ เติมความรู้สึกมีชีวิตและความมหัศจรรย์ให้กับฉาก ความมืดจึงทำหน้าที่สร้างความน่าค้นหา ส่วนแสงสว่างเปิดพื้นที่ให้ตีความถึงความหวังและการเดินทางต่อไป เป็นการใช้ Visual Storytelling ช่วยเตรียมอารมณ์ของผู้ชมให้เข้าสู่โลกของการแสดง ผลงานออกแบบ LED Visual ประกอบการแสดงแสงสีเสียง “Boon Phawade The Musical” โดยวิทยาลัยนาฏศิลปร้อยเอ็ด ในงานบุญผะเหวดร้อยเอ็ด 2569 ณ ลานสาเกตนคร จังหวัดร้อยเอ็ด สนใจงานภาพประกอบการแสดง LED Visual และ Motion Graphic ทักแชตมาคุยไอเดียกันได้ครับ เจมส์งานดี | JAMES NGANDEE GOOD IDEAS. d: The Witch Next Door: The Legend of the Mangkukulam 🇵🇭🧙‍♀️ In small Philippine villages, the scariest monsters don't hide in the wilderness—they look just like the neighbor who waves to you every morning. 👥👁️ This is the legend of the Mangkukulam, the practitioner of black magic and voodoo in Philippine folklore. She needs no physical claws or wings to harm you. All she needs is a single item that belongs to you—a strand of hair, a scrap of clothing, or a nail clipping. With it, she creates a doll linked directly to your life. When a pin is driven through its chest, an unexplainable pain strikes, leaving doctors completely clueless. Elders say to be careful who you offend and what you give away... because the Mangkukulam doesn’t need to see you. She only needs to remember you. 💀🍂 📌 If you love dark urban legends and ancient folklore, hit that Like button, Subscribe to our horror community, and share your thoughts in the comments below!   Tagalog version -  Sa mga maliliit na baryo sa Pilipinas, ang pinakamababagsik na halimaw ay hindi nagtatago sa kagubatan—kadalasan, kamukha lang sila ng kapitbahay mong kumakaway sa iyo tuwing umaga. 👥👁️ Ito ang alamat ng Mangkukulam, ang nagtataglay ng itim na mahika at kulam sa mitolohiyang Pilipino. Hindi niya kailangan ng matatalas na kuko o pakpak para saktan ka. Ang tanging kailangan niya ay isang bagay na nagmamay-ari sa iyo—isang hibla ng buhok, piraso ng damit, o gupit ng kuko. Mula rito, gagawa siya ng isang manika na direktang nakatali sa iyong buhay. Kapag ang karayom ay itinusok sa dibdib nito, isang hindi maipaliwanag na sakit ang tatama sa iyo na mag-iiwan sa mga doktor na walang mahanap na lunas. Sabi ng mga matatanda, mag-ingat sa kung sino ang iyong ginalit at sa mga bagay na ipinamimigay mo... dahil hindi kailangang makita ka ng Mangkukulam. Kailangan ka lang niyang matandaan. 💀🍂 📌 Kung mahilig ka sa mga madidilim na urban legend at sinaunang folklore, i-hit ang Like button, mag-Subscribe sa ating horror community, at ibahagi ang iyong opinyon sa comment section sa ibaba! #Mangkukulam #Philippine #Pinoy #ScaryStories #UrbanLegends #Folklore #BlackMagic #Kulam #Community #NightmareFuel #SpookySeason #PinoyTikTok #storytime #halloweenlook #Mythology #scary #horror #filipino #philippines🇵🇭 #philippinestiktok

d: MOMEN HARU BAYI USAI OPERASI, TAPI BENARKAH VIDEONYA NYATA?  Sebuah video yang memperlihatkan momen ketika perban mata seorang bayi dibuka setelah operasi kembali menyentuh perhatian warganet. Dalam video tersebut, keluarga terlihat begitu emosional. Tangis pecah ketika sang bayi dipeluk setelah perban pada matanya dibuka. Momen itu menggambarkan betapa besar rasa lega dan kasih sayang keluarga setelah melewati masa yang tidak mudah. Namun, ada satu hal yang perlu diperhatikan. Keaslian video tersebut belum dapat dipastikan. Sejumlah warganet mempertanyakan visualnya dan menduga video dibuat atau dimanipulasi menggunakan teknologi artificial intelligence (AI). Karena belum ada keterangan resmi yang dapat memverifikasi asal-usul dan proses pembuatan video tersebut, sebaiknya kita tidak langsung menganggapnya sebagai rekaman kejadian nyata. Yang pasti, secara medis, penggunaan penutup atau perban pada mata anak setelah tindakan operasi memang dapat dilakukan untuk melindungi area mata selama masa pemulihan, sesuai jenis prosedur dan arahan tenaga medis. Terlepas dari apakah video ini nyata atau merupakan hasil rekayasa digital, pesan yang dibawanya tetap mengingatkan kita pada satu hal: Kasih sayang keluarga selalu menjadi bagian penting dalam menemani seorang anak melewati masa sulit.  Tetapi di era AI seperti sekarang, jangan lupa satu hal: viral belum tentu benar. d: Video seorang bayi yang diduga diayunkan sembilan kali di atas kepulan asap ramai menjadi sorotan di media sosial. Sejumlah warganet khawatir paparan asap dapat berdampak pada kesehatan bayi yang masih berusia hitungan hari. WHO menyebut bayi dan anak-anak lebih rentan terhadap polusi udara karena paru-parunya masih berkembang. Dokter dan tenaga kesehatan juga menyarankan bayi dijauhkan dari asap pembakaran karena dapat mengiritasi saluran pernapasan dan meningkatkan risiko gangguan pernapasan. Praktik menggunakan api atau asap dalam tradisi pascakelahiran sebenarnya ditemukan di sejumlah daerah Indonesia.  Di NTT dikenal tradisi Sei, sementara di Madura terdapat praktik pengasapan bayi yang secara turun-temurun dipercaya dapat menghangatkan dan melindungi bayi. Adapun video yang beredar diduga memperlihatkan Pedak Api atau Pedaq Api, tradisi masyarakat Sasak di Lombok, NTB. Ritual ini dilakukan setelah tali pusar bayi lepas sebagai bagian dari pemberian nama, doa, dan harapan keselamatan bagi bayi. Seperti tradisi lain yang diwariskan turun-temurun, praktik tersebut memiliki makna bagi masyarakat yang menjalankannya. Namun, aspek keamanan dan kesehatan tetap perlu diperhatikan, terutama karena melibatkan bayi yang masih rentan. #SeenToday #TradisiIndonesia #Bayi #budayaindonesia

d: Bayi Reflux? 👇 Pernah menidurkan bayi setelah menyusu, lalu tiba-tiba ia menggeliat, menangis, atau terbangun karena merasa tidak nyaman? Itu bukan tanpa alasan.. dan bukan berarti bayi sedang “rewel atau cengeng.” ❌ Sering kali, penyebabnya adalah *udara yang terperangkap di dalam perut + gravitasi yang bekerja melawan mereka.* Saat menyusu (terutama bayi di bawah 4 bulan), bayi dapat menelan udara bersamaan dengan ASI atau susu. Jika udara tersebut tidak keluar, bisa menyebabkan: • perut kembung • rasa tidak nyaman • sering terbangun • gejala yang mirip reflux • tidur yang sering terputus ✨ *Apa yang benar-benar bisa membantu:* ✔️ Sendawakan bayi selama dan setelah menyusu ✔️ Gendong bayi dalam posisi tegak selama 15–30 menit setelah menyusu ✔️ Hindari langsung membaringkan bayi jika ia terlihat masih tidak nyaman ✔️ Biarkan gravitasi membantu proses pencernaan sebelum tidur Langkah kecil ini bisa memberikan perubahan besar pada kenyamanan dan kualitas tidur bayi 🌙 Ketika bayi merasa nyaman secara fisik, mereka akan lebih mudah tenang dan beristirahat dengan lebih baik 🤍 💾 SIMPAN postingan ini untuk waktu setelah menyusui ❤️ BAGIKAN kepada orang tua yang sedang menghadapi malam dengan bayi yang sering kentut, kembung, atau tidak nyaman ☎️ 0812 8832 4760 (Whatsapp) 📍Ruko Grand Galaxy RSK 2 No 7 Kota Bekasi Selatan ⏰ 10.00 - 18.00 - Buka Setiap hari #babysleepawareness #gentlesleep #newborncare #refluxsupport #babysleeptips

(You can remember only the word “phrá•aa•thít” = sun (common used) but most of Thai words in this video, They are mostly found in Thai poetry, literature, traditional writing, and sometimes in song lyrics. These are examples of คำไวพจน์ (kham wai-phót) different words that can have the same or very similar meanings, often used to make writing sound more beautiful, expressive, or poetic Thai students actually learn these in Thai language class at school, especially when studying literature, poetry, and composition. So if you’re learning Thai as a foreigner, Don’t worry, you definitely don’t need to use all of these words in daily conversations 🇹🇭 This video is just a fun comparison between: What foreigners learn in Thai class 🇹🇭 VS What Thai students actually learn in Thai class 🇹🇭 And yes… Thai people study Thai too. 😂 #learnthai #speakthai #thaiwithfah #learnthailanguage #thailanguage

d: Whenever I am super hungry I crave this easy, and so delicious beef! Quick dinner recipe! Today I’m making an easy beef stir-fry with peppers, onions and a garlic-ginger sauce that’s too good to leave in the pan. Make some rice to go with it. You’ll see why! The sauce is simple: soy sauce, fresh garlic and ginger, a splash of vinegar and just a little brown sugar. Together with the beef, sweet red pepper and onions, it makes a lovely homemade dinner for those evenings when you’re craving takeout. The poblano pepper is optional, so you can leave it out. The green onions are optional too, although I really recommend adding them at the end! Serve this pepper steak over rice or with noodles, and spoon some of the sauce over the top. There’s no need to make anything complicated on the side. I hope this gives you a new idea for dinner this week. Tell me in the comments what you would serve with it, and let me know how it turns out when you make it. I love hearing about the recipes you try. Subscribe to Essen Recipes for more simple homemade dinners with beef, chicken, potatoes and the everyday ingredients you already enjoy cooking with. Enjoy the cooking! Lots of love, Sophie

d: Try this mouthwatering Mutton pulao and thank me later 😌 Ingredients: 5 tbsp oil Mutton, cut into 1–1½ inch pieces 2 tbsp tomato purée 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste 2 tomatoes 1 fried onion 5–6 cloves 2 bay leaves 2 cinnamon sticks ½ tbsp whole black pepper 2 black cardamoms 2½ glasses water 2 garlic bulbs 4–5 dried red chillies 1 tbsp black pepper powder 1 tbsp cumin powder 1 tbsp coriander powder 1 tbsp salt 1 glass soaked rice Method of Preparation: Heat oil in a pot, add mutton and fry until lightly golden. Add tomato purée and sauté. Add ginger-garlic paste, chopped tomatoes and fried onion. Mix, cover and cook on low flame for 5 minutes. Add cloves, bay leaves, cinnamon, whole black pepper and black cardamom. Mix well. Transfer to a pressure cooker. Add water, garlic bulbs, dried red chillies, black pepper powder, cumin powder, coriander powder and salt. Close the lid and cook for 10 minutes after the first whistle. Allow the pressure to release naturally. Add the soaked rice, close the lid and cook on very low flame for 6–8 minutes. Turn off the heat, let it rest for a few minutes, then open the lid and allow the steam to escape. Transfer to a serving plate and enjoy with raita! #fyp #viral #mutton #pulao #rice

d: padakjeon 🐓💪🏻🥵 #alexcooks  tinggi protein tapi satset, juicy dan anti seret!!! gurih seger asik wajib recook sekarang jugak~ untuk 2-3 porsi bahan: 2 dada ayam, iris tipis 2 daun bawang 2 sdm kecap asin 1 sdt saus tiram 1/4 sdt garam 1/3 sdt kaldu bubuk 1/4 sdt micin 2/3 sdt gula 1/3 sdt lada hitam 4 sdm tepung kentang (bisa diganti 3 sdm tapioka + 1 sdm tepung beras) 2-3 sdm air saus: 2 cabe rawit merah, iris tipis 2 cabe rawit hijau, iris tipis 1/8 bombay, iris tipis 4 sdm kecap asin 1 sdm cuka 3 sdm air cara membuat: 1. Iris tipis bagian putih daun bawang. Masukkan ke mangkok bersama dengan dada ayam, bumbu, tepung dan air. Aduk rata dan marinasi sekitar 30 menit. 2. Potong bagian hijau daun bawang agak memanjang. Gulung lalu iris tipis. Rendam di air es. 3. Saus: campurkan semua bahan ke mangkok lalu aduk rata. 4. Tuang minyak secukupnya ke pan antilengket. Masukkan ayam, ratakan. 5. Masak di api sedang sekitar 6-7 menit. Balik lalu masak lagi sisi satu lagi selama 6-7 menit hingga keemasan dan garing. Pindahkan ke piring. 6. Tata daun bawang di atasnya, sajikan dengan saus.

d: 📌Save this for later! One of those Indonesian meals I can never say no to🤤 Ayam penyet, warm rice, and sambal ijo Simple, messy, and SO good🤌🏽 1 kg chicken thighs (4 pieces) Spice blend: 5 garlic cloves 15 g ginger 7g turmeric 1 lemongrass 1 tsp coriander powder 1 tbsp salt 1 tsp mushroom bouillon 1/2 tsp white pepper Sambal: 125g green chilies 15 green bird's eye chilies 4 garlic cloves 1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp mushroom bouillon A slice of lime 80 ml hot oil Instructions: 1. Blend the spice paste. Mix it with the chicken and the rest of the marinade, then marinate in the fridge for 2 to 3 hours. 2. Fry the chicken over medium heat until golden and cooked through. Then turn the heat to high until golden brown and crispy. 3. Fry the green chilies, bird's eye chilies, and garlic over medium heat for 1 minute. 1. Grind them and season with the salt, mushroom bouillon, and lime. 1. Pour the 80 ml hot oil over the sambal. Serve with the chicken.

d: Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.

d: Mom’s Indonesian Beef Rendang 🇲🇨   What I grew up eating for over 17 years back in my hometown, Indonesia🇲🇨😍. Today, I share this recipe with you, in honor of Indonesia's Independence Day. Happy Independence Day Indonesia, Indonesia MERDEKA! 🇮🇩✨ Ingredients A: 1.4kg of beef, topside or silverside, diced into 4cm chunks 800ml of regular coconut cream 400ml of coconut milk 1 tbsp of chicken powder 1 tbsp of Sugar 2 tsp of salt 2 tbsp of coconut sugar 6 tbsp of vegetable oil for stir fry  Ingredients B, to blend: 15 cloves of garlic  3 medium onions or 250g, chopped 30g of ginger,, cut into small pieces  30g of turmeric, cut into small pieces 6 candlenuts 30g of galangal, cut into small pieces 4 stalks lemongrass, chopped 6 tbsp of vegetable oil, to blend Ingredients C: 5 bay leaves 8 kaffir lime leaves 4 lemongrass, chopped 8 cloves wholes 3 cinnamon sticks 4 cardamoms 4 star anises Seasoning: 2 tsp of cilantro ground 2 tsp of turmeric ground 2 tsp of white pepper 2 tsp of cinnamon powder Steps: 1. Cut the beef into 4cm chunks and do not cut the beef into smaller pieces as they will break down during the cooking. 2. Add all of the Ingredients B in a blender or food processor. Then, blend it or give it a blitz until all the become a thick paste. Set aside 3. In the heavily-bottomed pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. 4. Then, pour the paste (from Ingredients B) into the pan and cook the paste until fragrant for 2 minutes. 5. Add the “Ingredients C” to the pan and stir to mix. 6. Next, add the “Seasoning” and followed by chicken powder, sugar and salt to the pan. Cook the paste until fragrant ( the paste will change color to red-brown ish ) 7. Add the beef to the pan and cook the beef until it is lightly browned.  8. Add coconut milk into the pan and stir to combine. Then, add coconut cream and bring it to simmer. 9. Cover and simmer in low heat for 1 hour until the beef is tender and the sauce thickens. (Stir it periodically to prevent the meat from burning) 10. Once the sauce has thickened and released reddish oil, add coconut sugar and give it a final mix. 11. Cover and simmer for another 30 minutes until it turns into dark brown. 12. Once it is done, enjoy with a bowl of rice! Notes: You should let the meat sit overnight for the flavors to be fully absorbed in the meat #indonesianfood #beefrendang #dinnerideas #easyrecipes

d: 🥩 DAGING SAPI MALBI KHAS PALEMBANG! DAGING SAPI EMPUK DENGAN BUMBU REMPAH 🇮🇩🤎 | 다깅 사삐 말비! 향신료 풍미 가득한 인도네시아식 소고기 조림 🇮🇩🤎 🥩 Hari ini aku membuat Daging Sapi Malbi, masakan khas Palembang, Sumatera Selatan, Indonesia! Daging sapi dimasak dengan kecap manis dan berbagai rempah seperti pala, cengkeh, dan kayu manis hingga bumbunya meresap sempurna🤎 Dagingnya empuk banget, dengan perpaduan rasa manis, gurih, dan aroma rempah yang khas. Kuahnya juga kaya rasa, sedikit kental, dan cocok banget dimakan bersama nasi putih hangat! Aku suka banget bagaimana rasa kecap manis berpadu dengan rempah-rempahnya. Rasanya berbeda dari masakan daging sapi Korea, tetapi justru itu yang membuatnya semakin menarik! Satu lagi masakan Indonesia yang berhasil bikin aku jatuh cinta!😊🩷 🥩 오늘은 인도네시아 남수마트라 팔렘방 지역의 전통 소고기 요리, 다깅 사삐 말비(Daging Sapi Malbi)를 만들어봤어요! 소고기에 케찹 마니스와 육두구, 정향, 계피 등 다양한 향신료를 넣고 양념이 깊게 배어들도록 푹 조리했습니다🤎 부드럽게 익은 소고기에 달콤짭짤한 양념과 향신료의 풍미가 어우러져 정말 매력적이었어요. 특히 진하고 살짝 걸쭉한 소스가 따뜻한 흰밥이랑 너무 잘 어울리더라고요! 한국식 소고기 장조림이나 갈비찜과 비슷한 듯하면서도 향신료 덕분에 완전히 다른 매력이 있었어요. 케찹 마니스 특유의 달콤한 감칠맛도 정말 좋았습니다! 이번에도 인도네시아 음식의 새로운 매력을 발견한 것 같아요. 정말 맛있게 잘 먹었습니다😊🩷 📧: bora97086@gmail.com YouTube: Rarari vlog TikTok: rararivlog Instagram: rararivlog #DagingSapiMalbi #MalbiPalembang #MasakanIndonesia #다깅사삐말비 #IndonesianFood

d: Ini kali kedua saya masak rendang dalam hidup saya. Yang pertama waktu tinggal di Lombok menggunakan ayam dan yang kedua vegetarian menggunakan kacang merah dan kentang. Dan keduanya di request oleh orang yang sama. Di Lombok paling mudah karena semua bahan tersedia, tantangan di US tidak mudah mendapatkan semua bahan yang di butuhkan terutama kelapa parut. Untuk seluruh bahan ini saya peroleh dari setiap toko Asia dari hampir 7 negara bagian yang saya pernah kunjungi di US sejak tinggal di sini. Akhirnya seluruh bumbu masakan Indonesua lengkap dan saya semakin pede karena tutorial nya langsung dari adik ku yang asli orang Padang. Dari Deni @Agustina_Sri dan pengalaman ke dua ini barulah saya mengetahui apa bedanya Kalio dan rendang. ang this is it, rendang vegetarian tanpa kelapa gongseng made in by me from North Carolina #rendang #vegetarianfood #madeinlove #indonesianfood

d: INDO MAAND DAG 20🇮🇩 Als het koud is wil ik maar één ding eten: smoor djawa! Dit Indonesische stoofvleesgerecht lijkt op Rendang, maar is totaal anders! Het is net zo smaakvol, maar bevat een stuk minder ingrediënten. Het is echt een van mijn favorieten en daarom deel ik hem ook heel graag met jullie!! Ingrediënten 500g stoofvlees 300ml water Stukje ongezouten roomboter 1 grote sjalot 1 eetlepel djahé Halve eetlepel zwarte peper Theelepel verse nootmuskaat 1 theelepel kristalsuiker Scheutje azijn Flinke scheut ketjap manis (2,5 tot 3 eetlepels) 2 teentjes knoflook 6 kruidnagels 2 trostomaten 1 lombok 1 maggiblok rund Bereiding Stap 1. Haal het vlees uit de koelkast en laat op kamertemperatuur komen. Snijd ondertussen de ui en  lombok in dunne ringen en de knoflook fijn. Daarna snijd je de tomaten in blokjes. Stap 2. Verwarm een beetje boter in een braadpan en bak je stoofvlees halfgaar op hoog vuur. Probeer een korst te krijgen op het vlees (niet noodzakelijk als dat niet lukt). Haal het vlees uit de pan en bak in het vet van het vlees de ui, knoflook 3 tot 4 minuten. Stap 3. Voeg de lombok en het vlees weer toe. Voeg daarna de gestampte kruidnagel, nootmuskaat, djahé, kristalsuiker, maggiblok, zwarte peper, azijn, water, tomaat en ketjap toe. toe. Roer dit goed door en bak 4 tot 5 minuten mee zonder deksel.  Stap 4. Zet je pan op de kleinste pit met het vuur op de laagste stand, doe de deksel op de pan en laat voor 4 tot 5 uur sudderen. Roer om de 20 tot 30 minuten even door en zorg dat er altijd genoeg vocht in de pan zit. Selamat makan!❤️

d: This ain’t your average dumpling 🥟 Craving juicy pork & shrimp dumplings but too lazy to fold? Same 😮‍💨 Meet these viral Blanket Dumplings!! 🔥 Juicy, flavorful, and wrapped in the easiest way possible. No folding, no fuss… just little blankets of deliciousness 🤤🔥 📍Save this for your next dumpling craving & tag someone who needs to try these! 💗 ✨ Hailey’s Blanket Dumplings 🥟 Ingredients * 1 lb ground pork * 10 shrimp, chopped * 2 green onions, chopped * 1 tsp chicken powder * 1 tbsp oyster sauce * 1.5 tbsp soy sauce * 1/2 tbsp sugar * 2 tsp minced ginger * 1 tbsp cooking wine (optional) * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 5 tbsp low-sodium chicken broth * Dumpling or wonton wrappers * Cooking oil * Low-sodium chicken broth, for steaming (start with 5 tbsp, add more as needed) For topping * Green onions, chopped * Sesame seeds * Chili oil  Instructions 1. Make the filling In a large bowl, combine ground pork, chopped shrimp, green onions, chicken powder, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, minced ginger, black pepper, cooking wine (if using), and chicken broth. Mix thoroughly in one direction until the filling becomes sticky and well combined. 2. Shape the dumplings Lightly grease a nonstick pan with cooking oil. Using a cookie scoop or spoon, place evenly sized balls of filling directly into the pan, leaving some space between each one. 3. Add the blankets Place a dumpling or wonton wrapper over each meatball, then gently press the edges down firmly against the bottom of the pan to seal them tightly. 4. Pan-fry and steam Drizzle a little oil over the dumplings, then add about 5 tbsp of low-sodium chicken broth. Cover with a lid and cook over medium-low heat for about 10–15 minutes, or until the filling is fully cooked and the wrappers are tender. Add a little more chicken broth as needed to keep the wrappers moist. 5. Finish and serve Remove the lid and let any remaining broth evaporate. Allow the bottoms to crisp up slightly, then garnish with chopped green onions, sesame seeds, and your favorite chili oil. #asmrfood #mukbang #lazydumplings #fyp

d: #tiktokfood #asmr Creamy Garlic & Chili Cheddar Ramen 🍜 Serves 2 INGREDIENTS 2 instant ramen cakes, seasoning packets removed 1½ tbsp unsalted butter 5 garlic cloves, finely chopped 2 green onions, sliced (whites and greens separated) ½ cup heavy cream 2 tsp chili oil, plus extra for serving 2½ tsp soy sauce 1 tsp rice vinegar ¾ tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp brown sugar ¼ tsp garlic powder ¼ tsp black pepper ½ cup freshly grated cheddar ½ tsp toasted sesame oil ¾ cup reserved noodle water, used as needed Toasted sesame seeds and optional chopped chives METHOD 1. Mix the cream, chili oil, soy sauce, vinegar, bouillon, brown sugar, garlic powder and pepper in a small bowl. 2. Boil the ramen until the strands separate but still have a little bite. Save ¾ cup of the cooking water before draining. 3. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Stir in the garlic and green onion whites for about 45 seconds, keeping the garlic pale. Add the cream mixture and ¼ cup of the noodle water. Let it gently bubble around the edges for 1–2 minutes. 4. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the cheddar a little at a time until smooth. Keep the sauce below a boil. 5. Add the noodles and toss until cooked through and coated. Loosen with a splash of reserved water as needed. Remove from the heat, then stir in the sesame oil and half the green onion greens. Finish with the remaining green onion, sesame seeds, optional chives and an extra drizzle of chili oil. Serve immediately!

d: Pad Kra Pao 🇹🇭🌶️ My favorite Thai Dish of all time. And a true staple to the Thai people. Pad Kra Pao is sweet, spicy, salty, and umami. It packs a huge flavor punch and is relatively simple to make! “Kra Pao” in Thai literally means holy basil which is what is traditionally used for this dish. But depending on where you live it can be hard to find.  Ive tried it with holy basil, regular thai basil, and even common italian basil, they were all delicious so use what you can find! Ingredients: 1/2lb minced pork Thai Chilis (to preference) 5-8 Cloves Garlic Generous handful of Thai Basil, Holy basil, white basil, or regular Italian basil (last resort) Sauce: 1.5 tsp dark soy sauce 1.5 tsp oyster sauce 1 tsp fish sauce 1 tsp sugar 1 tsp msg #thaifood #padkrapao #thailand

d: Steak Pasta 🥩 Ingredients: Steak Pasta Butter Rosemary Garlic Heavy cream Chili pepper Black pepper Parmesan Pasta water Salt Sear the steak on both sides until golden brown. Add butter, rosemary and garlic, and baste the steak with the melted butter. Remove from the pan, season with salt and pepper, and let it rest. In the same pan, add a garlic clove and sauté briefly. Pour in the cream, add chili pepper, black pepper, Parmesan and a little pasta water. Stir well until the sauce becomes creamy. Add the cooked pasta and toss until evenly coated with the sauce. Slice the steak and serve over the creamy pasta. Pasta con Steak 🥩 Ingredientes: Filete de ternera Pasta Mantequilla Romero Ajo Nata para cocinar Chile Pimienta negra Parmesano Agua de cocción de la pasta Sal Dora el filete por ambos lados. Añade la mantequilla, el romero y el ajo, y baña la carne con la mantequilla derretida. Retira de la sartén, salpimenta y deja reposar. En la misma sartén, añade un diente de ajo y sofríelo brevemente. Vierte la nata, añade el chile, la pimienta negra, el parmesano y un poco de agua de cocción de la pasta. Mezcla bien hasta obtener una salsa cremosa. Incorpora la pasta cocida y mezcla hasta que quede bien cubierta con la salsa. Corta el filete en rodajas y sírvelo sobre la pasta cremosa. #steakpasta #creamypasta #steakrecipe #pastarecipe #homemadecooking

d: Making Cajun Shrimp & Sausage pasta in my room! 🦐🤤 — I would make this everyday if I could. Pretty much a one pot meal! What should I make for Halloween? 👀  Order Lazy Pot on Amazon! Ingredients: * Cajun sausage * Medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails removed * Salt * Black pepper * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Cayenne pepper * Paprika * Red pepper flakes * Parmesan cheese * Heavy cream * Butter * Rigatoni or pasta of choice * Fresh parsley * Sliced baguette Instructions: * Season shrimp and sliced Cajun sausage with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, cayenne, paprika, and red pepper flakes. * Melt butter in a large pan and cook sausage until browned. Add shrimp and cook until pink and opaque. Remove both and set aside. * Boil pasta in salted water until al dente. Meanwhile, toast baguette slices in butter until golden and crispy. * In the same pan used for the shrimp and sausage, melt additional butter and pour in heavy cream. Stir over medium-low heat to create a smooth sauce. * Gradually add grated Parmesan cheese, stirring until melted and thickened. Add additional seasonings to taste. * Add cooked pasta and toss until evenly coated in the creamy Cajun sauce. Add a splash of pasta water if needed. * Return the cooked shrimp and sausage to the sauce, reserving a few pieces for plating. Mix well. * Plate the pasta and top with reserved shrimp and sausage. Finish with freshly chopped parsley for color. * Serve with toasted buttered baguette slices on the side for dipping into the sauce!  #food #pasta #easyrecipe #cooking #dinnerideas

d: 🥬🦐 เปาะเปี๊ยะสดเวียดนาม หรือเมี่ยงสด หรือสลัดโรล มาพร้อมกับน้ำจิ้มถั่ว เมนูอร่อย ไส้แน่น กินแล้วสดชื่น! ได้ประโยชน์ครบถ้วน 💚 ใครชอบเมนูผัก ๆ ต้องลองเลยค่ะ 🌯 แผ่นแป้งเวียดนามห่อด้วยผักสดกรอบ ๆ เพิ่มความอร่อยด้วยเส้นและเครื่องต่าง ๆ ตามชอบ จะใส่หมูหรือกุ้งก็เข้ากันสุด ๆ ห่อเป็นชิ้นพอดีคำ กินคู่กับน้ำจิ้มรสเด็ด ยิ่งกินยิ่งเพลินค่ะ 😋 ทำกินเองก็ง่าย ปรับไส้ได้ตามใจชอบ ทั้งอร่อยและได้ความหลากหลายในคำเดียว ใครเห็นแล้วอยากลองทำตามบ้างคะ 💚 ***วัตถุดิบส่วนผสมไส้เปาะเปี๊ยะสด*** หมูสับ 200 กรัม ถั่วงอก 100 กรัม แครอทหั่นเส้น 100 กรัม เกลือป่น 1/2 ชช. ผงปรุงรส 1/2 ชช. น้ำตาลทราย 1 ชช. น้ำมันพืช 1 ชต. ***ส่วนผสมน้ำจิ้มถั่ว*** ถั่วลิสงคั่วบดหยาบ 3 ชต. พริกจินดาแดง 10 เม็ด กระเทียมจีน 5 กลีบ น้ำปลา 2 ชต. น้ำมะนาว 2 ลูก น้ำเปล่า 2 ชต. น้ำตาลมะพร้าว 1 ชต. ผงชูรส 1/2 ชช. เกลือป่น 1/4 ชช. ***อื่นๆ*** - ผักสลัด, ใบชะพลู, ใบโหระพา, ใบแมงลัก, ต้นหอม, ผักชี, แตงกวา, หัวปลีซอย, ผักอื่นๆตามชอบ - เส้นขนมจีน, หมูยอลวก, แผ่นแป้งเวียดนาม ***วิธีทำ*** 1.  ล้างผักทุกชนิดให้สะอาด แล้วผสมเบคกิ้งโซดา 1/2 ช้อน ต่อน้ำ 5 ลิตร แช่ผักทั้งหมดทิ้งไว้ 15 นาที แล้วล้างให้สะอาดอึกครั้ง ส่วนหัวปลี เอากาบที่แก่ๆออก เอาแต่กาบที่อ่อน ซอยบางๆแล้วแช่น้ำที่ผสมน้ำมะนาว เพื่อป้ิองกันไม่ให้ปลีกล้วยดำคล้ำ 2.  ผัดไส้เปาะเปี๊ยะ โดยตั้งกระทะให้ร้อน ใส่น้ำมันพืชลงไป ตามด้วยหมูสับ ผัดจนหมูสุกใส่ถั่วงอกและแคอทหั่นเส้นลงไปผัดให้เข้ากัน จากนั้นปรุงรสแล้วผัดคลุกเคล้าให้เข้ากันอีกครั้งก็ปิดเตา ยกลงไปพักให้เย็น 3.  หั่นหมูยอให้เป็นเส้น แล้วลวกให้พอสุก  4.  นำแผ่นแป้งเวียดนามจุ่มน้ำแล้ววางแผ่ลง นำผักวางเรียงลงตรงกลาง วางชนิดไหนก่อนหลังก็ได้ โปะด้วยไส้หมูสับ หมูยอและเส้นขนมจีน แล้วค่อยๆม้วนห่อให้แน่น 5.  เพิ่มเนื้อสัตว์ชนิดอื่นได้ตามชอบ เช่นกุ้ง ปลา เนื้อไก่ ฯลฯ 6.  หั่นเป็นชิ้นพอดีคำ จิ้มกับน้ำจิ้มถั่วรสเด็ด อร่อยมากๆๆ #เปาะเปี๊ยะสดเวียดนาม #เปาะเปี๊ยะเวียดนาม #เมนูสุขภาพ #SeaSunCookingChannel #ปอเปี๊ยะสด

d: ✨ ซาลาเปานมสด ไส้หมูสับไข่เค็ม สูตรนวดมือแค่ 10 นาที แป้งที่ได้มีความนุ่มฟู ไส้ก็รสชาติเข้มข้นกลมกล่อม  อร่อยลงตัวมากๆ **อัตราส่วนไส้** หมูบดติดมัน 500 กรัม แครอทหั่นเต๋า 30 กรัม เห็ดหอมหั่นเต๋า 5 ดอก ต้นหอมซอย 2 ต้น ซีอิ๊วขาว 3 ชต. น้ำมันหอย 5 ชต น้ำมันงา 1 ชต. น้ำตาลทราย 4 ชต. พริกไทยป่น 1 ชต. แป้งข้าวโพด 4 ชต. ไข่แดงเค็ม (ใช้แบบดิบหรือนึ่งสุกก็ได้) **อัตราส่วนแป้งซาลาเปา** แป้งกิเลนเหลือง 380 กรัม (สามารถใช้แป้งเค้กแทนได้) นมสดรสจืด 260 กรัม (เข้าไมโครเวฟให้พออุ่นๆ) ยีสต์ผง 2 ชช. น้ำตาลทรายขาว 40 กรัม ผงฟู 2 ชช น้ำมันรำขาวหรือน้ำมันพืช 4 ชต. กระดาษรองซาลาเปา **นมสดจะต้องอุ่นๆเอามือแตะได้ ไม่ร้อนจัดเพราะจะทำให้ยีสต์ตาย **พักส่วนผสมของเหลว (นมสด+ยีสต์+น้ำตาลทราย) ไว้ 5 นาที เพื่อเช็คการทำงานของยีสต์ ยีสต์ที่ทำงานจะทำให้ส่วนผสมของเหลวฟองฟูขึ้นมา **นวดแป้งแค่พอเนียน ไม่ต้องถึงขนาดขึงเป็นฟิล์มได้ และพักแป้ง 40 นาที ถึง 1 ชม.หรือจนกว่าแป้งจะขึ้นเป็นสองเท่า **หลังจากห่อไส้ก็ให้พักแป้งอีก 40 นาที **นึ่งด้วยไฟกลาง 12 นาที **หากทานไม่หมดสามารถเก็บใส่กล่องแช่ตู้เย็นได้ 3-4 วัน เวลาจะทานก็นำมาเข้าไมโครเวฟสัก 15-30 วินาที แป้งจะนุ่มนิ่มเหมือนเดิม **ซาลาเปาที่ผ่านการอุ่นต้องรีบทานให้หมด เพราะแป้งจะแข็งกว่าเดิมได้ #ซาลาเปานมสด #ซาลาเปานวดมือ #แม่ซีน้องมดดี้channel

d: 🇵🇭 Chicken Sotanghon | Soups so good it can cure any sickness Ep. 32 Chicken Sotanghon is one of those Filipino comfort food that just hits, especially when you want something bolder other than your usual chicken noodle soup. My take is very garlic forward with a collagen rich broth  *Most measurements are estimates. Season and adjust to your liking :)* INGREDIENTS: Chicken & Broth: - 1 whole chicken, portioned - water or chicken stock, as needed (chicken stock just makes it extra rich and chickeny) - bay leaf - Salt and ground black pepper, to taste Soup: - Annatto oil for frying - 10-15 cloves garlic, minced - 1 red onion, chopped - 1/2 cup celery, chopped - shredded chicken - Reserved chicken broth as needed - Fish sauce to taste - Black pepper to taste - Annatto seeds (atsuete), for coloring  - sotanghon noodles (vermicelli noodles) - 1 large carrot, julienned - 1 Chinese cabbage, chopped - Quail eggs as needed, boiled and peeled  Toppings: - Spring onions - Crispy garlic bits INSTRUCTIONS: - Portion the chicken and place it in a pot with bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Pour in the chicken stock and water, then simmer for around 40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and tender. Remove the chicken and reserve the broth. Once cool enough to handle, remove the bones and shred the meat. - Heat the annatto oil, then lightly toast the minced garlic. Add the onion and chopped celery. Stir in the shredded chicken and pour in the reserved broth. Season with fish sauce and black pepper. - Place the annatto seeds in a fine-mesh strainer and dip them into the simmering soup, stirring gently until the broth turns a vibrant reddish-orange. Remove the seeds. - Add the sotanghon noodles and cook until they begin to soften. Follow with shredded Chinese cabbage, julienned carrots, and boiled quail eggs. Simmer until the vegetables and noodles are cooked through. - Ladle into a bowl, finish with chopped spring onions and crispy garlic.Serve hot and enjoy! #ASMR #CookingASMR #Soup #Soupsogood

d: 🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

d: Crispy Air Fried Pork Belly Lechon 🇵🇭🔥 w/ a Sweet & Spicy Bagoong Dipping Sauce! All this goodness in just 2hrs tops! 🤯 I made this for all my guests on football Sunday, and let me tell you, it was straight up SMACKIN! I’m literally drooling just thinking about it as I type this caption. 😂 If you’ve been following me for a few years, you already know I’ve made crispy pork belly just about every way imaginable. Some methods I’ve done multiple times just to perfect them. I love the challenge, and you already know how much I love that smoke flavor! But I’ve seen many making crispy pork belly in the air fryer, so I figured it was time to give it a shot with my own spin on it. And I gotta tell you, they weren’t lying about how easy and delicious this method is! I did mine a little differently, cooking it at a lower temperature for a longer period to really render down that fat. That was THE MOVE! Perfectly rendered fat, juicy and tender meat, and that ridiculously crispy, crunchy skin! 💯 Now pair all that with a Sweet & Spicy Bagoong Dipping Sauce, made with Filipino fermented shrimp paste, and you’ve got an absolute UMAMI BOMB that’ll blow your socks off! 🤯 One MONEY AF recipe right here! 💯💰🔥 Marinade Paste: • 1 tbsp garlic paste • 1 tbsp lemon grass paste • 1/4 cup vinegar  • 1 tbsp soy sauce • 1 tbsp onion powder • 1 tbsp @Bear & Burton's W-Sauce Dipping Sauce: • 2-3 tbsp Bagoong (found at Asian or Filipino markets) • 1/4 cup cane vinegar or white • 1 tbsp @Melinda's Hot Sauce Sriracha • 1 tbsp @melindasfoods Hot Honey • 1-2 tbsp crispy fried garlic Instructions: 1. Poke holes on the skin side using a meat tenderizer. 2. Score meat side then apply marinade paste. Massage into the meat.  3. Place pork on foil and create a boat. Brush on white vinegar then apply a heavy coat of kosher salt evenly.  4. Into the @Ninja Kitchen air fryer at 300F for 1-1.5 hrs.  (I cooked it until the fat was rendered how I like it) 5. Remove salt then brush avocado oil then back into the air fryer at 400F for 30 min until the skin is completely crispy. Check periodically after the 1st 10 min to make sure it’s not burning.

d: 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood

d: Episode 5: Homemade Garlic Longganisa 🇵🇭 (Pinoy-Style) Ingredients:  900 g ground pork 150 g pork fat (optional) 20 cloves garlic, finely minced 1/4 cup brown sugar 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp white vinegar 1 tsp paprika 2 tbsp cornstarch 1 tbsp salt 1 tbsp black pepper Natural hog casing  Kitchen twine Procedure:  1. Rinse and soak the hog casing in water for 1 minute. Drain well. 2. Mix the ground pork, garlic, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper, paprika, cornstarch, and cold water until sticky and well combined. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours 3. Stuff the mixture into the casing, being careful not to overfill. Twist and tie with kitchen twine. 4. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight to slightly dry the casing. Then freeze overnight. 4. To cook, place the longganisa in a pan with ¼ cup water. Cover and cook over medium heat until the water evaporates. Add 1–2 tbsp oil and fry until golden brown and cooked through, reaching 71°C / 160°F internally. You can add any seasoning but make sure you mix it well with the meat! Pwede adobo flavor or any. Enjoy my recipe and tag me pag nakagawa na kayo! ☺️ #ChefYlyt #privatechef #easyrecipes #homemade #longganisa

d: Nilagang Baka (Filipino Beef and Vegetable Soup) A cozy, comforting soup of tender beef ribs simmered in a savory broth with hearty vegetables. Best enjoyed with steamed rice and a bit of fish sauce on the side. Ingredients * 4 lbs beef ribs, cut into single pieces * 1 large onion, halved * 1 Tbsp garlic powder * 1 Tbsp black pepper * 1 Tbsp kosher salt * 2–3 beef bouillon cubes * 8 cups water * 2–3 bay leaves * 2–3 ears yellow corn, cut into thirds * 2 russet potatoes, cut into large chunks * 1 bunch bok choy, cleaned and trimmed * 2 Tbsp fish sauce (or to taste) Instructions 1. Cook the Beef: In a pressure cooker or Instant Pot, combine beef ribs, onion, garlic powder, bouillon cubes, pepper, bay leaves, and water. Pressure cook on high for 15 minutes, then let it naturally release for another 15 minutes before opening the lid. No pressure cooker? Simmer on the stovetop for 2–3 hours until ribs are fork-tender. Add water if the broth reduces too much or becomes too salty. 2. Cook the Vegetables: While the beef is cooking, boil potatoes in salted water until fork-tender (15–18 minutes). Add corn and simmer for another 5 minutes. Blanch bok choy for 1 minute and set aside. 3. Adjust the Broth: Once the beef is done, taste the broth. Adjust with more bouillon, salt, or fish sauce as needed. 4. Assemble and Serve: Add the cooked vegetables to the beef broth. Serve hot with steamed white rice and extra fish sauce on the side if desired. Enjoy! #nilagangbaka #bulalo #beefsoup #filipino #filipinofood #easyrecipe #easy #recipe #food #foodies #foodlover #dinner #lunch #dinnerideas #lunchideas

d: Ginataang Manok  Ingredients: 4 Chicken thighs and 4-6 drumsticks Kosher salt for seasoning the chicken 1/2 onion, sliced 3 cloves garlic, minced 3/4 Cup water 2 Cans coconut milk 1 Anaheim Pepper 3 Fresno chillies (optional) use 1-2 Thai chili if you like it spicy 1 Chicken Bouillon Cube 1 Tbsp Black pepper 1 Tbsp Fish sauce 40g Ginger, cut in slices 1 Large potato 1 Large Carrot Bok Choy Instructions 1. Season the chicken generously with kosher salt. For the best flavor, refrigerate and let it season overnight. 2. Heat a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken skin-side down until golden brown and the fat has rendered, about 5–7 minutes. Flip and cook for 1 more minute, then remove from the pot. 3. In the same pot, sauté the onions for 2–3 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Pour in the water and coconut milk, then stir in the ginger, bouillon cube, fish sauce, and black pepper. Return the chicken to the pot. 5. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered over medium-low heat for 15 minutes. 6. Add the potatoes, carrots, and Fresno chilies (if using). Continue simmering for another 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are fork-tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 7. Taste the broth and adjust the seasoning if needed. 8. Serve hot with steamed white rice. #ginataangmanok #filipino #recipe #food #easyrecipe

d: ✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

d: Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

d: Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

d: Crispy Steak Mac & Cheese 🥩🧀 Ingredients 1 lb cavatappi 16 oz mozzarella 12 oz Colby Jack 8 oz sharp cheddar 4 oz Fontina 3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour 12 oz evaporated milk 2 cups heavy cream 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder & smoked paprika 1 tsp chicken bouillon ½ tbsp Dijon Reserved pasta water 1 large ribeye or NY strip Salt, pepper & garlic powder 1 tbsp oil + 1 tbsp butter Directions 1. Cook pasta 1 min shy of al dente; reserve 1 cup pasta water. 2. Melt 3 tbsp butter, whisk in flour and cook 2 min. Slowly whisk in evaporated milk, then cream, seasonings, bouillon & Dijon. Simmer 3–5 min. 3.Turn heat LOW. Melt in 4 oz each Fontina, mozzarella, Colby Jack & cheddar (16 oz total). Save the remaining 24 oz cheese for layering. 4. Add pasta. If too thick, loosen with reserved pasta water until very creamy. 5. Add half the mac to a baking dish → 8 oz reserved cheese → remaining mac → remaining 16 oz cheese. 6. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 25–30 min, then broil 1–3 min until golden and crispy. 7. Season steak and sear in oil about 3–4 min per side. Add butter and baste. For medium-rare, pull around 125–128°F and rest 8–10 min. 8. Rest mac 5–10 min, slice steak and pile it on top.  #macandcheese #comfortfood #easyrecipe #steak #cooking

d: Honey chipotle chicken wraps! 🌯 #Hungry #Lunch  What you need for the salad 🥗  2 red onions  2 Bell peppers 🫑  1 cucumber  1 Iceberg lettuce  Dice and put these in a bowl 🥣  For the chicken 🍗  2kg boneless chicken thighs, cut into small cubes  1 tsp Tandoori spice blend  1 tbsp Italian Aromat all purpose seasoning  1 tbsp smoked paprika 2 tbsp Dark soy sauce  1 tbsp chili powder 1 tsp garlic granules  2 red onion, diced Mix these up and leave for 30 minutes so it marinates, ideally should be 1hr30min for the best balance of flavour.  What you need for the Honey chipotle sauce 🥣 4 tbsp of fat free Greek yoghurt (my preference) or 8tbsp Mayonnaise  1/2 tbsp of honey 🍯  2 tbsp of ketchup  1 tbsp of peanut butter 🥜 (my preference) 1/2 tbsp of chilli powder  1 squeezed lemon juice 🍋 30g of Chopped flat free Parsley 🌿  Give these a mix!  How to cook! 👨🏾‍🍳🫕 Firstly, season your diced chicken and leave in the refrigerator for 30min so it marinates. ideally they should be left for 1hr30min for the best balance of flavour 🙂 While waiting it’s should be the best time to make the honey chipotle sauce. 🧠😉 (recipe above, pls go back if you’ve missed it 🙂) Dice all you need for your salad options and leave in a bowl 🥗🥣  Get your frying pan out, using olive oil, cook your chicken for 5-7 minutes per sides at 165°C–175°C When the chicken’s cooked add a little portion of your honey chipotle sauce and mix  For dressing your tortilla 🫓 Place on your tortilla, your creamed up diced chicken, salad, lettuce (to prevent your sauce from dripping), Mozzarella cheese and some sauce on top to go with.  Fold nicely and Toast on fire in a low heat to avoid your warp getting burnt.  Voilaaaa! You just made a honey chipotle chicken wrap 🌯😉

d: First time making soul food for dinner, I loved it 🤤 Fried chicken and corn bread recipe from @Toni Chapman  Mac and cheese recipe is already up on my page!  Yams:  3 large sweet potatoes seasoned heavily with cinnamon  8 tbsp (1 stick) unsalted butter  1.5 cups dark brown sugar  1 tbsp cinnamon  Grated nutmeg 1 tbsp Vanilla bean paste  pinch of salt  Baked at 400 degrees for 60-90 mins varying by thickness of sweet potatoes    Brown butter roasted banana pudding: Custard- 3 roasted bananas 6 large egg yolks 2 cans evaporated milk 1/2 cup dark brown sugar 1/4 cup cornstarch  1 vanilla bean pod  pinch of salt 3 tablespoons unsalted butter + 1 tbsp whole milk powder (browned) -Cream cheese  1 cup sweetened condensed milk 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste  Whipped cream: 2 cups HWC  1/2 cup dark brown sugar  1 tbsp vanilla bean paste  pinch of salt  1 bag vanilla wafers  Instructions: Roast 3 bananas at 350 for 20 mins or until fully brown and soft. Blend half a can of evaporated milk with bananas and add with additional 1.5 cans of evaporated milk, and 1 vanilla bean pod (paste or extract work too) to a saucepan and heat over medium low heat. In a bowl whisk yolks, brown sugar, cornstarch, and salt. Temper the mixture slowly to avoid scrambling, sift custard back into saucepan, and cook until thickened. Once thickened add in brown butter, sift back into a bowl, cover with plastic wrap (touching the custard), and allow to cool fully. Mix cream cheese, condensed milk, vanilla paste and salt until smooth, then add and fold into cold custard. Fold in whipped cream and reserve a portion to add top layer. Add in wafers, and finish with more cookies. Let sit in fridge a minimum of 6 hours, preferably 12+.  #friedchicken #collardgreens #macandcheeserecipe #macandcheese #bananapudding

d: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

d: High Protein Cheesy Chicken Alfredo Rolls🍗🧀🌯 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Roll - 10 Total) 438 Calories 25gC | 13gF | 65gP Want more recipes like this? check out my high protein cook books with over 300 recipes 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients:  1.7KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika, 1 Tsp Onion Powder, 1 Tsp Garlic Powder, 1 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Olive Oil 1 Large Diced Brown Onion 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 450g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 35g Grated Parmesan Cheese 100ml Low Fat Milk 2 Tsp Italian Herb Seasoning, 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper, 1/2 Tsp Salt 60g Light Cream Cheese 10 Warm Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Mozzarella (per roll - 10 total) Egg Wash or Light Cooking Oil Spray Topping: Grated Parmesan Cheese & Parsley Flakes Instructions: 1. Slice chicken into fillets. Season with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder & salt, drizzle with olive oil and mix. 2. Cook in a pan over medium-high heat for approximately 4 mins per side or until cooked through. Set aside and dice. 3. Cook onion in the chicken juices until softened. Add garlic and diced chicken, mix well, then turn off the heat. 4. Blend cottage cheese, parmesan, milk, Italian herbs, salt & cream cheese until smooth. 5. With the heat completely off, add the sauce, mozzarella & parsley to the pan and mix well. 6. Add 1/10th of the filling to each warm tortilla, add mozzarella, then roll tightly. 7. Place on a lined baking tray. Brush with egg wash or spray with oil, then top with parmesan & parsley flakes. 8. Bake at 190°C/375°F for 8 – 12 mins or until golden brown & crispy. #chicken #alfredo #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

d: Garlic parmesan chicken tenders Ingredients  For the chicken marinade : 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into strips and pounded  3 cups buttermilk  Salt to taste 1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 tsp mustard powder  1 tbsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp black pepper powder  1 tbsp white vinegar  Oil for deep frying  For the dry batter  2 cups all purpose flour  3/4 cup corn starch  2 tsp baking powder  Salt to taste 1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 tbsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp black pepper powder  For the garlic parmesan glaze 4 tbsp butter 1 tbsp fresh garlic, finely chopped  1 teaspoon red chili flakes Or 1 red chili , chopped  1 tbsp parsley, chopped  1/3 cup Parmesan cheese, fresh grated  1/2 cups mayonnaise  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 tsp black pepper  Salt to taste 1 tbsp lemon juice  For the spicy garlic parmesan sauce  1/3 cup mayonnaise  1/4 cup garlic parmesan glaze 2 tbsp hot sauce  Method  Method Mix buttermilk, seasonings, and vinegar. Add chicken, cover, and refrigerate for 2–4 hours. Combine all dry batter ingredients. Let excess marinade drip off chicken, then dredge in the flour mixture, pressing firmly. For a craggy coating, rub 2–3 tbsp marinade into the flour to create small clumps. For extra crunch, dip chicken back into marinade and dredge again. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches for 4–6 minutes until golden and cooked through (165°F/74°C internally). Transfer to a wire rack. For the glaze, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and cook for 30–60 seconds. Add chili and cook briefly. Remove from heat, stir in parsley and Parmesan, and cool slightly. Whisk in mayonnaise, garlic powder, pepper, lemon juice, and salt until creamy. Mix mayonnaise,1/4 cup glaze, and hot sauce to make the spicy dip. Toss hot tenders in just enough glaze to coat. Garnish with Parmesan and parsley. Serve immediately with the spicy garlic Parmesan sauce #recipe #garlicparmesan #tenders

d: Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ
